verdict.summary_en: Chinese/English delivery note SN-260827-134 from Guangzhou PackRight Packaging to Soony DC Hamburg, dated 2026/08/27, for PO 4500318704. One line: PR-RB-2207 Collector's Box Grand Heist 6, 17,500 PCS in 3 packages, 51 kg gross, carrier Nordhav Shipping A/S. Stamped RECEIVED 30.09.2026 DC-HAM. The recipient signature line is blank. No handwritten corrections.
red_flags: Receiving signature line (收货签字) is blank, so no named receiver confirmed the goods.
Received stamp (30.09.2026) is about a month after the note date (2026/08/27), which could be transit time or a delay.
Gross weight of 51 kg for 17,500 collector's boxes in 3 packages looks very low. The document does not explain this, so check it against the packing list.
Item description is cut off ('(rig'), so the full product name cannot be confirmed.
The received stamp has no quantity, so the receiving quantity is not confirmed separately from the printed quantity.
observations: Red round supplier seal (出货专用章, Guangzhou PackRight Packaging Co. Ltd) overlaps the unit and package-count columns. The unit reads PCS, and the package count '3' is partly covered, so it is marked unclear.
Blue rectangular stamp 'RECEIVED 30.09.2026 DC-HAM' is placed below the table.
Description text in the table is truncated at '(rig'.
No handwriting on the page. The lower half of the page is blank.
A barcode is printed at the top right.
